_readme: Installed as .github/zethus.config.json in YOUR repo; edit it there. Every key is optional: the scripts and agent fall back to repository evidence, then ask. Key names match Amphion's .claude/amphion.config.json wherever they overlap (gates, branchModel, docSync), and the scripts read that file when this one is absent.
_jiraReadme: Everything below is only read by the optional Jira integration skills (see docs/jira-skills.md). Leave it out entirely if you haven't installed spec-to-stories or story-enrich.
_modernizationReadme: Everything below is only read by the optional modernization extension (see docs/modernization-shared.md). Leave it out entirely if you haven't installed those skills and scripts.
